summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the 4 new Sparepart features (Filter Kategori HSC, Cache Auto-refresh / Sync HSC, Preview Import, Riwayat Import) plus regressions on the PHP-native simbeng_v1 app. All 11 pytest backend tests pass (login, HSC search auto-detect, short-query guard, preview-baru no-write, commit-baru writes + import_logs, preview + commit upgrade with restore, sync_hsc GET returns catalog_count>0 & last_sync, sync_hsc POST updates settings.last_hsc_sync + returns inserted/updated/errors/duration_sec, stock autocomplete regression, page load). Full Playwright frontend walkthrough passes end-to-end: HSC search 'shock' yields 25 live results, filter chip row (hsc-filters) renders 21 chips including 'Semua 25' + tipe chips (AKSESORIS 6, FZ750 1, SIGMA 1, ...), clicking AKSESORIS narrows to 6 results, clicking Semua restores 25; Sync Sekarang button triggers POST /ajax/sync_hsc.php, hsc-sync-info timestamp updates from '31/08/2026 23:23' -> '31/8/2026, 16:26:09', hsc-msg shows 'Sync selesai: 183 baris, +0 baru, ~183 update, 0 error'; uploading a CSV renders preview modal with badges (Baru:1, Update:0, Dilewati:1, Invalid:0) and per-row status badges; Batal closes modal AND leaves DB untouched (verified PVW-UI-CANCEL absent); Konfirmasi Import commits row, page auto-reloads and Riwayat Import table shows new log with user 'Administrator'; regression: HSC autofill of kode/nama/kategori works, stock page autocomplete for 'OLI' still returns OLI-001.
critical_code_review_comments: parts.php is 568 lines and mixes PHP, HTML, and inline JS (import modal template, sync handler, chip filter, autofill). Consider extracting the JS block into /app/bengkel/assets/js/parts.js and the modal HTML into a PHP partial for maintainability.
ajax/import_parts.php duplicates the 'insert into categories' handling that already exists elsewhere. Not blocking but consider centralising.

ajax/sync_hsc.php POST has no explicit timeout / lock; if a click races with the hsc_sync_daemon (24h cron) two runs could interleave. Consider adding a settings-based advisory lock (last_hsc_sync_in_progress) so parallel sync clicks return early. Not blocking (duration ~a few seconds).

In parts.php the filter chip row (hsc-filters) is re-rendered on each filter click causing element re-attachment; Playwright had to re-query chips after each click. Not a bug, but a hasClass toggle would be lighter than full re-render.
seed_data_creation: During tests: PVW-1 (mode baru commit) and OLI-001 (mode upgrade preview+commit). Both cleaned up in test teardown - PVW-1 removed via subprocess PHP DELETE, OLI-001 restored to original name/harga via a follow-up upgrade call. A Playwright-created part 'PVW-UI-<random>' from the confirm flow is also cleaned up. Small residue: 6 rows in import_logs table remain (visible as 'Riwayat Import: 6 log') but the ones this iteration created (filename TEST_pvw.csv and tmp*.csv) were deleted; other 5 pre-existed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new sparepart features are working correctly end-to-end. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_simbeng_php.py; run with pytest -o addopts= (or use existing xdist config). Key insight: (1) 'import-history-table' testid is only rendered when import_logs has rows; check for 'import-history-card' / 'import-history-count' first. (2) Testing 'preview did not write' via the parts page requires strict 'KODE' matching because the search box echoes the ?q= parameter as an input value, causing false positives. (3) Playwright clicks on filter chips re-render the chip row, so re-query chips after each click. (4) sync_hsc POST can take up to a minute for the full popular-keyword refresh; wait up to 90s.
rca of the issue: No production bugs found in this iteration. Test authoring issues encountered and fixed: (a) initial pytest assertion for preview-no-write matched the search input's value attribute ("PVW-1") instead of a table cell, false-positive fixed by asserting 'PVW-1'; (b) frontend chip Semua-restore initially failed because the ElementHandle became stale after the chip row re-rendered - fixed by re-selecting chip via ':has-text()' locator; (c) Playwright cancel-button click with force=True + no post-modal-show settle time occasionally left the Bootstrap modal visible - resolved by adding a 600ms settle after modal 'visible' state and using normal click. All are test-harness issues, not app bugs.
